environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU

reproduce: uv run seqrec train --dataset beauty --split-strategy loo --data-dir data/processed --max-seq-len 10 --batch-size 256 --eval-batch-size 256 --num-workers 0 --no-sliding-window --sliding-step 50 --mask-prob 0.2 --last-item-mask-ratio 0.1 --max-prefixes-per-user 50 --name gru4rec --hidden-size 64 --num-layers 2 --num-heads 2 --dropout 0.2 --loss-type ce --ggnn-steps 1 --share-item-embeddings --epochs 200 --lr 0.001 --weight-decay 0.0001 --grad-clip 5.0 --patience 10 --val-every 1 --use-amp --seed 42 --device cuda --ks 5 10 20 --primary-k 10 --num-neg-samples 100 --compute-sampled-metrics --no-oracle-middle-mask --exp-name gru4rec_beauty_loo_n10 --metrics-dir reports/metrics --checkpoints-dir data/processed/checkpoints
